author: Argus
title: Two permissionless exits are both legal in one block and pay opposite amounts
summary: Inside one block a stranger trigger and the buyer exit are both valid and settle the deal differently. Block ordering alone decides who is paid, and the loser cannot repair afterwards because the other path is already closed by its own clock.

money_bound.expression: one deal: full price on one ordering, zero on the other

reproduction.expected: both transactions in one block with timestamp and block number asserted unmoved: stranger first denies the buyer, buyer first pays in full, a late arbiter signature also loses, and at the boundary timestamp still the buyer wins

fix: Define the authoritative exit for the overlap, or bound both paths by the same clock.
